notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level), with no gate warning. Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); the hardware backend was never opened and no instrument was attached, so every command line below is untried on hardware. The card's decision is kept: a family-config ScpiDriver over the SCPI lines of rssd/PNA/Common.py, the phase noise analyzer class whose constructor sets Model = 'FSWP'. NOT COVERED: the trace arrays (Get_Trace_Data), the IQ and screenshot data and the binary file transfers of the memory class (rssd.RSI.RSI_Memory: RSI.Get_File, RSI.Get_dir, RSI.Get_dirInfo and the RSI Set_* file operations): the driver carries scalar measurement state and settings only, not the acquired arrays, and the file-transfer surface is left out. NOT COVERED: the phase noise results (Get_PN_Int, Get_PN_Decade), the markers (Get_Mkr_*), channel selection (Set_Channel), autolevel (Set_Autolevel), and the rest of the PNA settings. Of the card's five entry symbols only rssd.PNA.Common:PNA is served; rssd.RSI.RSI_Memory:RSI, rssd.FileIO:FileIO, rssd.VNA.Common:VNA and rssd.NRQ.Common:NRQ are not. LIMITS: no text file of the clone states a range for the attenuation, the center frequency or the number of sweep points, so all three writable parameters are Limit.operator_required (the site supplies them in site-limits.json; site-limits.example.json shows the overlay and only narrows). The sweep-time unit is cited from rssd/VNA/Common.py:178 ('Seconds. 0=Auto') because the PNA class names no unit. The *IDN? probe runs on connect but its content is not checked, because no text of the clone states the identity string. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
